proposals: The Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare should publish an explanatory note on the proposed Central Seed Committee, giving the rationale for cutting state seats from 22 to 5, so the provision farmer groups are actually contesting is argued on the record rather than left out of official messaging.

The Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare should publish a summary of comments received by the 11 December 2025 deadline and the department's response to each main issue, so it is visible which changes, if any, the consultation produced before the bill is introduced.

The Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare and the PPV&FR Authority should issue a joint note setting out how the bill's registration regime interacts with farmers' rights under the 2001 Act, so the conflict critics allege is either answered or addressed in the text.

The Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare should state whether the 'Seed Traceability Portal' and the existing SATHI portal are the same system, so dealers and farmers know which platform the QR-code requirement will run on before penalties attach to it.

The Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare should publish the list of organisations and minutes of the 10 September 2026 consultation, and announce future consultations with a stated minimum notice period, rather than one day's notice.
